examples.title: Reject a misleading choropleth
examples.summary: Raw counts on unequal-area polygons are rejected before a renderer artifact exists.
examples.document:
version: "0.1"
map: district-population
title: Population count by district
description: An intentionally unsafe raw-count choropleth used to demonstrate semantic rejection.
family: choropleth
intent:
  task: compare
  audience: general-public
  primary_message: Compare district population without normalizing for polygon area.
data:
  sources:
    - id: districts
      type: geojson
      url: ./data/districts.geojson
  fields:
    district_name:
      source: districts
      path: name
      measurement: nominal
      semantic_type: label
    population_count:
      source: districts
      path: population
      measurement: quantitative
      semantic_type: count
      unit: people
      normalization: none
      range:
        - 0
        - 500000
encoding:
  geometry:
    source: districts
    support: polygon
  color:
    field: population_count
    classification: continuous
  label:
    field: district_name
constraints:
  colorblind_safe: true
  missing_data: explicit
  raw_count_choropleth: reject
  viewport:
    width: 960
    height: 640
basemap:
  style: minimal-light
  contrast: light

diagnostics.message: Raw counts on unequal-area polygons require normalization or an explicit override.

examples.title: Compile a normalized probability map
examples.summary: A declared probability range and explicit missing-data policy compile into renderer-valid layers.
examples.document:

map: flood-risk
title: Flood risk by district
description: Compare district flood probability while keeping missing values visible.
family: choropleth
intent:

      measurement: quantitative
      semantic_type: probability
      unit: ratio
      normalization: ratio
      range:
        - 0
        - 1
    district_name:
      source: districts
      path: name
      measurement: nominal
      semantic_type: label
encoding:
  geometry:
    source: districts
    support: polygon
  color:
    field: flood_probability
    classification: continuous
  label:
    field: district_name
constraints:
  colorblind_safe: true
  missing_data: explicit
  raw_count_choropleth: reject
  viewport:
    width: 960
    height: 640
basemap:
  style: minimal-light
  contrast: light

decisions.reason: probability semantics determine the default palette family.

examples.title: Enforce area-proportional symbols
examples.summary: The compiler derives square-root radius scaling so symbol area—not radius—tracks capacity.
examples.document:
version: "0.1"
map: shelter-capacity
title: Emergency shelter capacity
description: Locate shelters and compare their available capacity.
family: proportional-symbol
intent:
  task: compare
  audience: operations
  primary_message: Find high-capacity shelters near affected districts.
data:
  sources:
    - id: shelters
      type: geojson
      url: ./data/shelters.geojson
  fields:
    capacity:
      source: shelters
      path: capacity
      measurement: quantitative
      semantic_type: capacity
      unit: people
      normalization: none
      range:
        - 0
        - 1000
    shelter_name:
      source: shelters
      path: name
      measurement: nominal
      semantic_type: label
encoding:
  geometry:
    source: shelters
    support: point
  size:
    field: capacity
  label:
    field: shelter_name
constraints:
  colorblind_safe: true
  missing_data: error
  protected_layers:
    - symbols
  label_priority:
    - shelter_name
  viewport:
    width: 960
    height: 640
behavior:
  zoom_rules:
    - max_zoom: 9
      target: symbols
      action: cluster
    - min_zoom: 12
      target: labels
      action: show-labels
basemap:
  style: minimal-light
  contrast: light

decisions.reason: A semantic zoom rule requested point clustering.
Circle radius uses the square root of the quantitative value so area remains proportional.
